title: Rubric Revision Loop
user: Teachers with a large writing-feedback load who need to give reusable, criterion-specific feedback and make the student's next revision visible without outsourcing judgment to an LLM.
smallest_useful_product: Teacher-created rubric-code library, pasteable short feedback links, student revision checklist with before/after excerpt, and teacher review queue.
success_measure: A teacher reuses rubric codes for 50%+ of comments while 60%+ of students submit at least one linked revision explanation.
monetization: freemium — a free single-class workflow validates utility; small paid teams need shared rubrics and retention controls.
constraints: Student data minimization, FERPA/GDPR-aware deletion, no model training on student writing, accessible link-only student view.
